name: KolanHook
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.
rootCause: KolanHook settles its escrowed ETH buy-windows at the same Uniswap v4 pool's instantaneous spot price with no TWAP or bound and accept() is ungated once a window has expired, so the attacker flash-borrows 6.7 WETH from Balancer, swaps it to move the KLN spot, then calls accept() on two expired windows it does not own so _closeWindow() mispositions their escrowed ETH as single-sided liquidity around the manipulated price and runs an unbounded buyback, and reverses the swap back through that freshly placed ETH liquidity before repaying the loan for a 1.279453 ETH net gain. Lost: 1.279453 ETH net to the attacker EOA on Ethereum (surplus 1.279914429958618589 ETH after the 6.7 WETH Balancer flash loan is repaid, minus ~0.00046 ETH gas), draining KolanHook's full 2.309861 ETH of escrowed window funds
